featurise_input: featurise a folding input with MSA and templates into model-ready batches using the AlphaFold 3 pipeline
validate_fold_input: validate that a folding input contains required unpaired MSA, paired MSA, and templates for each chain
run_featurisation_pipeline: run the AlphaFold 3 featurisation pipeline on a folding input with configurable bucket sizes and MSA overlap resolution
process_folding_batches: process a folding input into feature batches for each RNG seed using the WholePdbPipeline
configure_featurisation_options: configure featurisation options including bucket sizes, conformer iterations, and reference date for chemical components
